facts.fact: Telecom Egypt's RDH1 data centre began operating in Q1 2021 and hosts most local ISPs, over 22 international cloud and content clients and the EG-IX exchange (Fintech Gate, 28 Aug 2026).
Fintech Gate reports Telecom Egypt's RDH1, in service since 2021, holds several Tier III certificates (issuer and date not given; the article's date 2026-08-28 is used).

systems.tiers: Uptime Tier III design certificate, Nov 2024; not yet in service

note: RDH2 (Tier III design certificate Nov 2024) is not yet in service, so no tier3 fact for it.
